monthly.source: the desks recorded in data/benchrec_eval/result.json; every group scored by benchrec.ts score() and scoreBaseline(); nothing re-learned, no model called

floor.test: precision >= 99.8%, i.e. wrong <= matched / 500; benchrec.ts clearsFloor uses >, which differs only at exactly 99.8%

the learned desk's submission equals data/benchrec_eval/submission.csv line for line
the months (by import and by value date), weeks and days each add up to the pooled numbers

byWeek.weekOf: the Monday of the bank line's import week

bootstrap.unit: whole import days (B_importDate), drawn with replacement; the same draws for every desk
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the resampled pooled precision (linear interpolation)
